name: trait_definitions
title: Definitions and scoring scope for each trait
description: One row per trait. `scored_for` is the load-bearing field: it records which lineages the trait was actually scored in, so a missing value is not mistaken for a negative.

fields.name: applies_to
fields.description: Lineages the trait is biologically meaningful for.

fields.name: scored_for
fields.description: Lineages it was actually scored in. Read this before treating absence as evidence.

fields.name: caveat
fields.description: Known problems with this trait as recorded.
